definitions.gloss: exactly; precisely; on the dot; sharp
definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that a time, amount, or measurement is exact with no deviation. Conveys a sense of precision and punctuality.

examples.japanese: きっかり3{時|じ}に{来|き}てください。
{会議|かいぎ}はきっかり1{時間|じかん}で{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The meeting ended in exactly one hour.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん}にきっかり{現|あらわ}れた{彼|かれ}に{感心|かんしん}した。
examples.english: I was impressed that he showed up precisely at the promised time.

notes:
An adverb emphasizing exactness, most commonly used with times and quantities. Has a slightly more emphatic, crisp feel than {ちょうど}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- きっかり〜{時|じ}: at exactly ~ o'clock
- きっかり〜{分|ふん}: exactly ~ minutes
- きっかり〜{円|えん}: exactly ~ yen

NUANCE:
Conveys a sense of precision and sometimes impressiveness at the exactness. Often used when the precision itself is noteworthy or deliberate.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ちょうど: just, exactly — the most common and neutral equivalent
- ぴったり: exactly, perfectly — emphasizes a snug or perfect fit
- きっちり: precisely, strictly — similar to きっかり but can also mean thoroughly or meticulously
